schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to carry heavy work tools or equipment?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في حمل أدوات أو معدات عمل ثقيلة؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, schweres Arbeitswerkzeug oder schwere Ausrüstung zu transportieren?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to carry heavy work tools or equipment?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که ابزار یا تجهیزات سنگین کار را جابه‌جا کنید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de transporter des outils ou du matériel de travail lourds ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy nehéz munkaeszközöket vagy felszerelést szállítani?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a portare attrezzi o attrezzature da lavoro pesanti?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, ağır iş aletlerini veya ekipmanlarını taşımaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
